supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.title: Guide
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.subtitl: What you are, and how it all works
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hu: You have not been touched yet. Anything that bites, blesses or marks you can start a path: a vampire's blood, a werewolf's bite, a witch's call, a hunter's oath. Your ladder is short until then.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_gh: You are turning. Drink human blood before the turning ends and you rise a vampire; fail and it ends in death. Until then only Path, Bloodline and this Guide open, and nothing on your path moves.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_va: You live on blood and the sun hurts you. Drink from the living to keep your thirst down, use Bite from the HUD, and climb the vampire ladder. Vampirism's own skill tree sits next to ours in the Skills page.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_or: The first of a bloodline. Your blood makes bottles and sires, and the ones you made answer to you. Nothing here can break your own line's bond, but others can try to sever theirs.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hy: Vampire and werewolf at once. You feed in human form, shift under the moon, and your venom poisons vampires. The moon decides when you shift; a pack gives you strength.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_or: The first hybrid of a line: an Original and a werewolf in one body. You keep an Original's blood and a wolf's rank, and your hybrids answer to you.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_tr: Vampire, werewolf and witch in one. You carry the rules of all three ladders; the hub shows each one under its own name.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_au: You were a vampire with no bloodline until the Rite of Augustine or Wes's Syringe made you this. You are a little stronger. Garlic Ward and Blessed Skin are skills you buy. The first bite on a vampire gives triple blood, and anyone else, a bottle or a station gives a third. Only a cure undoes it.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_he: A witch of the Heretic line: you draw on a coven's circle and answer for what it costs. Rites are where your path moves.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_wi: You cast through circles and rites. The Rite of Lineage reveals what blood carries, and your ladder grows with the rites you complete and the coven you keep.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_si: You take magic from what you touch. Siphoning feeds your own reserve, and the skills you buy shape what you can take and from whom.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_hu: You hunt the supernatural. Marks, instinct and a hunter's tools are your path; the creatures you track get weaker for you.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.race_we: You shift with the moon, and a full moon forces it. Your rank in the pack sets your strength; the Roar calls it together. Free Will gives you the shift at will.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.hub.bod: Home opens and closes it. The look button switches the style. The number keys 1 to 8 jump to a page, Tab moves through everything, Enter presses, Esc closes a dialog and then the hub.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.path.bo: A ladder of rungs for what you are. Finish a rung's tasks, claim them, and the rung rises: skill points and, with Tensura, EP follow. A task's tag says which mod it comes from.
Spend skill points on what your race's tree lists. A skill says what it needs and what it costs; Vampirism and Werewolves keep their own trees in their own tab.
One-off goals that unlock skills. Each lists its tasks; claim them as you finish.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.rites.b: The rites live in Enchanted's book, The Art of Witchcraft: carry it (craft it with a book, an ink sac, a feather and belladonna seeds), open the chapter Supernatural Bloodlines, or press the E seal in the hub. A rite shows as ??? until you learn it: by becoming its kind, by reading a grimoire or a torn page, or by performing it. Your path tasks name the rites they ask for.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.bloodli: Who made you and whom you made, and the genes you carry. Undiscovered genes stay stoppered until a Rite of Revelation or your own awakening opens them.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.pack.bo: Your pack gives you a bonus while its members are near. Alphas lead, Betas follow, and who is in or out is decided here. On a full-moon night wild werewolf packs may roam: they hunt vampires first, then hunters, then other players, then prey, and are fiercer in the dark. A werewolf who kills their Alpha gets a weaker spark that grows while they are online; until it has grown it counts for nothing and cannot be taken. Moonblood Surge (pack buff) and Wolf Spirits (Alphas) are on the Home page.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.loadout: Six slots on your HUD: R, F, V on the left of the hotbar and Z, X, C on the right. Pick an ability you know, then a slot. Bite is in slot 1 until you move it.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.guide.moon.bo: Eight phases over eight days. A full moon can force a werewolf's shift. The almanac on the Path page shows the next days; click it, or use Moon calendar on Home, for sixteen days with the full moons and any lunar events. A server can forbid werewolves (or everyone) to sleep on a full moon. A werewolf gene awakens at dusk, not at once: when something stirs in your blood, it will wake at a coming dusk.

Some of the Originals are in the world, not only in the book. Mikael is the first, Klaus the second, Elijah and Rebekah the third and fourth, Kol and Finn the fifth and sixth.

Mikael comes at night, now and then, for a vampire of rung 3 or higher on the vampire ladder. A server can change the rung and the chance. A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds him.

Klaus comes on a full moon, for a doppelgänger: a villager, or a player who carries the gene (a server can switch the player hunt off). A hunted player is warned before he arrives, and being hunted is how they find out they carry the gene. He shifts into a wolf at half health, or against a werewolf. The bite of the wolf is werewolf venom, which only works on vampires. His Blood cures it and counts as the blood of an Original hybrid. Werewolves must be installed. A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds him too.

Elijah is calm. He comes to someone who knows an Original, or carries one's blood, by day as well as by night, and he does not fight unless he is hit. Speak to him and he offers the blood of one NPC Original (any but himself) for an oath: for the in-game days the server sets, you will not harm or desiccate any NPC Original but Mikael, and you will not strike Elijah, and neither will anything you tame. Break the oath and he is hostile for good, and there is no second deal. His reward is the Elixir: carry it, and it brings you back from the next death that is not a line death, a command, a death that is part of turning into something, or the void, once.

Rebekah comes for whoever makes The Cure at the Rite of the Cure, a short while after, and hunts them. A Cure that was given or dropped does not call her. A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds her, and Elijah too. Her reward is the True Cure, which an Original can drink without being desiccated: it makes them human, and the ones they sired stay in their line.

Kol comes by night, now and then, for a Hunter of the Five whose mark has enough kills on it (12 unless the server changes it). He is fast and he leaps, and that is all he does.

A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds him. Bring him down and he drops Kol's Grimoire.

Read the grimoire once for skill points. A witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can then work the Rite of Cloaking with it: for 30 minutes (a server setting) the Vampire Compass and a hunter's sense do not find you. Dying ends the cloak, and the game tells you when it fades. The rite gives the grimoire back.

Finn comes on a lunar eclipse, to a witch type or a vampire, and works a ritual inside a ring of cold fire. Left alone, the ritual hurts no one: he finishes it, the people near are told, and he is gone for a week.

Hurt him for more than a fifth of his health, or pull him more than 24 blocks from the ring, and he breaks it off and fights. A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds him too. His reward is Esther's Grimoire.

The Linking Spell is a witch-type rite. Two living creatures stand in the circle (it is 11 blocks wide), and for a while half the damage one takes the other takes too, in your name. You may be one of the two if you stand in the circle. Esther linked her children this way.

It will not take an NPC Original, a boss, a creature that is linked already, or a player who has not agreed: they must sneak in the circle holding a lead in their main hand (a player Original may, like anyone), and where PvP is off no other player can be linked. Every one of those, and a count other than two, gets the same answer, "The link will not hold".

Each costs the same lead, amethyst and altar power, and the grimoire always comes back. That is deliberate, so a refusal never tells you which of the creatures or players was the reason.

Deucalion comes on a full moon night, once per world, for a player Alpha who stacks at least 3 sparks (a server can change the number). A True Alpha counts as holding the full stack, so he comes for them too. He brings Alphas of his own pack. He walks as a man in glasses, drops to fours when he first falls below three quarters of his health or when his target is within 8 blocks at night, and does not change back.

If he loses you, or leaves with the dawn, he is gone for that night; he comes again on a later full moon while you still stack enough sparks. (A server can let him come again after he has died.) A mountain ash line laid by a pack Emissary holds him.

He dies like any wolf. The reward is paid once, to the player who did the most to bring him down (a tie goes to the last blow; a pet's damage is its owner's). That player takes his sparks (4 unless the server changes it) by the rules of a stolen spark: an open and protected path to True Alpha destroys them, and the stack never goes above the cap. A True Alpha takes none and a player who is no werewolf gets nothing; the game tells them why. His pack gives no weak spark and no drops.

A werewolf who is paid also learns the Demon Wolf Roar (a True Alpha too). On the Alpha Roar's key, with a cooldown of its own, the other player Alphas within 32 blocks, not in your pack, are forced to shift. Not where PvP is off, and not your own team. A Beta is not.

Peter Hale waits in a burned Hale house, in a forest or a taiga. There may be many such houses, far apart, but there is only one Peter: he comes to whoever comes within 24 blocks of any of them first, and the others stay empty. A server can switch the houses off or make them rarer, and an admin can find one with /locate structure supernaturalbloodlines:hale_house. The chest holds a book about the fire.

He is a burned man until he has met a full moon, then a whole one. At half health, or on a full moon night, he drops to fours as the Alpha and does not change back. On a full moon night the wolf is feral: he attacks anything alive that is not a boss. He pounces from 3 to 4 blocks away, only at what he can see. A server can take the full moon rage away.

He dies like any wolf, once. The player who does the most to bring him down (a tie goes to the last blow; a pet counts for its owner) takes his Alpha spark by the rules of a stolen spark: a True Alpha takes none, an open protected path destroys it, the stack never goes above the cap, and a player who is no werewolf is told so. A server can let him be found again.

The Memory Claws lie where he fell, for anybody. Right-click a player who agrees on purpose: they face you, sneak with a lead in their main hand, PvP must be on, and you must be allowed to hurt them (no teams). You learn their sire and genes as they know them then, shown on their Profile page and never updated. They are told. 12 uses, 30 seconds apart.

The Beast of Gévaudan has a man to wear: the Host, in an old soldier's coat and tricorn, who stands out near an Alpha, a True Alpha or a Hunter of the Five on a full moon night, once, sometimes (a server can change the chance). Nobody can hurt him, because the Beast needs him. On a later full moon night he becomes the Beast. A werewolf can force it with the Rite of the Frequency: the Valet Pike (given back), a Hearing Device and an echo shard.

The Beast rears up and Roars: everyone within its reach (a server can change the range and how long the fear lasts) is shaken, except Alphas and True Alphas, who stand against it. It heals 2 health a second unless wolfsbane is on it, takes less from arrows, and a Hearing Device stuns it for one second only.

It cannot be killed: at a quarter of its health, or inside a closed ring of mountain ash (a server can let it walk through ash), it collapses. The Host stands up unhurt and the Spirit runs for a short while (a server can change how long). Only a direct blow of the Valet Pike hurts the Spirit, and one blow ends the Beast for good. If it gets away it comes back once at half health; the second time it is gone for good (a server can make the first escape final).

The Valet Pike is made by a witch type on a full moon night, from iron, wolfsbane, mountain ash dust and the bottled blood of an NPC Original, or of somebody at rung 4 or higher of the vampire or werewolf ladder, or a Hunter of the Five, an Alpha, an Original, a hybrid or a tribrid: a plain player's blood is not enough. A refusal about the blood always reads the same and spends everything; a caster who is no witch type gets everything back.

The player who does the most to the Beast takes its Mantle, once, even if they are away: it waits for them until they log in. It is a trophy for everyone but a shifted werewolf who wears it. The Mantle is its only reward: it leaves no spark, and no Valet Pike (the pike is only ever made by the rite). Without Werewolves there is no Beast.

Nothing but white oak kills an Original, and white oak only works on one who is already down. Any other defeat only desiccates them, and they get up after some days. While one lies open, their whole line is warned.

If your Original dies to white oak, you die too. So does everyone in their line, online or not. Open the Bloodline page to see whose line you are in.

Each boss pays one reward, the first time it is brought down.

supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.al: Calls the moon-crowned Alpha to the edge of the circle. Beat it before dawn to win a spark of your own.
Full-moon night only. Only a werewolf Beta or Omega in beast form, at or above the server's trial level (10 by default), can try it. Nobody else may stand on the centre.
If your path to True Alpha is still open, winning would end it for good: you are asked first, and the rite starts only once you answer (within 2 minutes).
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.an: Awakens the magic in the one on the centre: they become a witch or, with a 25% chance (a server setting), a siphoner.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does). It is refused for vampires, hunters, anyone who already has a species and anyone who is not human.
The roll is made when the rite runs. A refusal is shown to the caster and gives the ingredients back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.bl: Turns four bottles of blood and a stone into a Blood Stone, a block that adds power to an altar.
Anyone can perform it. The blood bottles are Vampirism's.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.cl: Washes the vampire side out of the one on the centre: a vampire becomes human again, a hybrid a plain werewolf, a tribrid a witch and a heretic a siphoner.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the vampire side. An Original or an Original hybrid cannot be cured by it.
A hybrid or a tribrid also loses its sire bond. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.cu: Curses the owner of the taglock: every second they lose 0.5% of their maximum magicules (at least 1), or 1% when the caster has a cat familiar.
Anyone can cast it. The target is the owner of the taglock; Tensura must be installed.
The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.
Curses the owner of the taglock: one of the skills they have learned is chosen, and it cannot be activated or switched on while the curse lasts. A sealed skill that is on is switched off.
Anyone can cast it. The target is the owner of the taglock; Tensura must be installed.
The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.

Curses a White Oak Ash Dagger into a Cursed one. Only the Cursed Dagger lodges in an Original hybrid as well as an Original; the plain one lodges only in an Original. Needs the dagger, 2 white oak ash and an echo shard.
Anyone can work it. A witch, a siphoner or a tribrid knows it from the start; the book keeps it sealed for the rest. It makes an item and acts on nobody, so there is no one to ask for consent.
Both daggers hurt a supernatural wielder alike. A miss looks the same for everyone the dagger does not lodge in; a lodge tells only what the rules make public.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.do: Fills a bottle with Doppelgänger Blood from the owner of the taglock, and tells a player owner whether they carry the gene.
Needs a filled taglock of a doppelgänger villager or of a player who carries the gene (a server can allow any human). The owner must be loaded or online.
A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.he: Makes a Hearing Device. Used, it stuns every supernatural creature within 5 blocks for 5 seconds (Slowness V and Nausea). You are spared.
Anyone can perform it. A player is stunned only where PvP is on (and not in creative or spectator mode).
The device needs 60 seconds to recharge after each use.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.hy: Fills a bottle with Hybrid's Blood from the hybrid on the centre.
The hybrid on the centre must be a hybrid, an Original hybrid or a tribrid. Someone else's blood needs their consent: they must sneak on the centre. Werewolves must be installed.
Without the consent, or if the one on the centre is not a hybrid, nothing is made, the bottle comes back and the caster is told only that the rite would change nothing: it never says who is a hybrid.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.im: Turns the human on the centre into an Original vampire.
Full-moon night only. The target must be human: no faction and no species. A villager must stand in the circle: it is the sacrifice, and it is killed.
A server can cap how many Originals exist; at the cap the rite is refused and the ingredients come back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.ma: Condenses your magicules into one Condensed Magicule: it takes 5,000 magicules from you (the server's rite file can change that).
Anyone can perform it. The magicules come from the caster, not from the altar, so this rite asks for no altar power. Tensura must be installed.
With too few magicules it fails: nothing is taken and the items come back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.or: Fills a bottle with Original's Blood that names the Original on the centre.

The Original on the centre must be an Original or an Original hybrid. Someone else's blood needs their consent: they must sneak on the centre. An Original's ladder can raise the number of bottles above one.

Without the consent, or if the one on the centre is not an Original, nothing is made, the bottle comes back and the caster is told only that the rite would change nothing: it never says who is an Original.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.pu: Strikes every undead creature within 8 blocks of the centre with holy damage (8 by default, 4 hearts). It hits Tensura undead and vanilla undead.
Anyone can perform it. Tensura must be installed; it needs nothing from Vampirism.
It does not tell friend from foe: undead allies within 8 blocks are hit too, and the reach is wider than the circle.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.ri: Wakes the werewolf gene in the one on the centre: a human becomes a born werewolf, a vampire a bound hybrid and an Original a bound Original hybrid.
Refused for hunters, for people who already are werewolves and for heretics. Werewolves must be installed.
A vampire or Original made a hybrid this way is bound: it cannot shift until the Rite of the Moon. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
Tells the one on the centre, and only them, whether they carry the werewolf gene, and marks the gene as known to them.
Anyone can perform it. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does). Werewolves must be installed.
A refusal always reads the same and still spends the lead, the amethyst and the altar's power. The grimoire always comes back.
Reveals every gene that was rolled for the owner of the taglock, yes or no for each, and the Original of their line.
Needs a filled taglock of a player: a villager's is refused. The owner must be loaded or online, and only they are told.
A refusal gives the ingredients back.
Breaks the sire bond of the one on the centre. The sire stays on record, but the bond is gone.
Full-moon night only. Only a witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can work it. The target must be sired with the bond whole, and Sire's Blood of their own sire must be among the items.
A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.
Frees one player from the line of their Original. They become the head of a line of their own, not an Original: their sire bond stays and the ones they sired stay in the Original's line.
Only a witch type can work it, under a lunar eclipse. It needs two bloods that pair: the Original's and the target's, who must be online here and not an Original.
A server can switch line rites off. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
Makes The Cure: one drink removes every vampire, werewolf and species layer from whoever drinks it.
Anyone can perform it, but a desiccated Original (or Original hybrid) player must be within 6 blocks of the centre, a little wider than the circle.
Making The Cure calls Rebekah to hunt whoever made it, a short while after. Without a desiccated Original the rite is refused and the ingredients come back.
Marks a hunter as a Hunter of the Five.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does): a hunter with no species, or a Potential. The Five must not be full (a server setting).
A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.
Traps an Original in a closed ring of mountain ash for the whole rite. At the end the target and their whole branch leave that Original's line, never the Original's whole line.
Only a witch type can work it, under a lunar eclipse. Needs the target's bound Sire's Blood; the target must be online here and not an Original.

Draw the ring first, inside the chalk and 6 blocks from the centre (a ring closing within 8 blocks works). The Original stands on the centre inside it, downed, dying or desiccated, and must be of the target's line.

The rite lasts 30 seconds (a server setting) and is checked twice a second. A broken ring, an Original who escapes, the eclipse ending or the caster or target leaving ends it with no effect, and the ingredients are spent.
Lets an Original with the werewolf gene become an Original hybrid, or frees a bound hybrid so that it can shift again.

Full-moon night only. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does); a villager and a wolf must stand in the circle: they are the sacrifice, and they are killed. Werewolves must be installed.
Anyone else is refused: the caster is told only that the rite would change nothing, and the ingredients come back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.si: Removes the werewolf side: a werewolf becomes human again, a hybrid or a tribrid a plain vampire. The gene stays.
Full-moon night only. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the werewolf side. An Original hybrid cannot be cured by it.
Werewolves must be installed. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.va: Makes a Vampire Compass: it points to the nearest vampire, hybrid or Original within 64 blocks. Sneak and use it to look for the nearest doppelgänger instead.
Only the holder learns anything: the one it points at is never touched or told.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.wa: Binds a Sun Ring to the one on the centre. While a vampire wears it, they take no sun damage.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the vampire side. An unbound Sun Ring must be among the items: a ring that is already bound is refused.
The Sun Ring does not stop the Weakness the sun gives.
Makes a Resurrection Ring with 3 charges. Worn, it cancels the death of a human killed by something supernatural: full health, Regeneration II for 10 seconds, one charge.
Anyone can perform it. The ring is not bound: whoever wears it is protected.

It saves only a human: no vampire or werewolf faction, and no species but Potential or Hunter of the Five. A witch or a siphoner is not saved. Only from supernatural killers, and only while it has charges.
Binds a Moon Ring to the one on the centre. While a werewolf wears it, they shift at will and are spared the forced full-moon shift.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be a werewolf. An unbound Moon Ring must be among the items: a ring that is already bound is refused.
Full forms need the Werewolves level the server sets; below it the ring gives half forms.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.we: Takes a beaten wild werewolf into your pack as a brother.

Only a werewolf, of any rank, can perform it. The wolf (a beast or a survivalist, not an Alpha, a trial boss or one already bonded) must be within 4 blocks of the centre at half health or less. It is not an ingredient.
You and your pack can have only so many brothers (a server setting). A refusal tells you why and gives the ingredients back.
supernaturalbloodlines.hub.rites.desc.pu: The same purification, worked with holy water instead of glowstone dust: holy damage (8 by default, 4 hearts) to every undead creature within 8 blocks of the centre, Tensura undead and vanilla undead.
Anyone can perform it. Tensura and Vampirism must be installed: the holy water is Vampirism's.
It does not tell friend from foe: undead allies within 8 blocks are hit too, and the reach is wider than the circle.
